messages:
bryan: strange behavior during onboarding: quickstart prints \"welcome! first call ok\" locally, but our automated test client gets a 302 and ends up with HTML. workspace created via trial invite, no payment info. anyone? :confused:

rei: have you captured the request/response? some gateway rule historically redirects browsers to the console checkout. automated clients should get a machine-readable error instead.

bryan: minimal curl that reproduces it:
```
$ curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-9' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
> GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Accept: */*
> Authorization: Bearer sk-test-9

< HTTP/1.1 302 Found
< Location: https://console.redwood-inference.example/billing/checkout?reason=trial
< Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
```

bryan: note: the node sample app uses fetch with default headers so it sends Accept: */* and our CI client follows redirects by default which turned the 302 into a 200 HTML snapshot.

rei: two problems: (1) gateway treating */* as HTML-preferring, (2) SDK/quickstart snippets not explicitly requesting JSON. SDKs should default to Accept: application/json.

ci-bot: SDK parity alert: Python and TS SDKs set Accept properly but Go and Rust quickstarts do not. filing DEVEX-6300.

ops: also saw the SDK retry wrapper considered 302 transient and retried POSTs, causing duplicate non-idempotent behaviour during onboarding. that's risky for streaming endpoints. we should make 3xx terminal for non-GET methods.

rei: short-term workaround: in CI set the client to not follow redirects or add header `Accept: application/json`. Example: `curl -v -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-9' ...` returns HTTP/1.1 402 + JSON with error {"code":"billing_required"}.

bryan: adding Accept fixed my snapshots. thanks.

sdk-bot: logged DEVEX-6300 (update quickstart snippets + SDK defaults) and INF-6301 (gateway content-negotiation patch + retry-rule change). will canary the gateway change.

ops: canary deployed to dev cluster at 3740001275, gateway now returns 402 JSON when Accept includes application/json or X-Requested-With is present. also changed retry behavior so 3xx is terminal for POST/PUT/PATCH.

bryan: confirmed canary: CI now observes 402 JSON and tests pass after switching to Accept header. will update quickstart README to mention billing gating and CI tips.

rei: follow-up actions: update Go/Rust quickstarts, add small test utility to detect billing-gate, and add a short note in onboarding docs about trial workspaces needing card for first production calls. leaving thread unless regressions appear.
